"Core Game Specification:
Create a 3D downhill mountain bike racing game deeply inspired by the PS2 classic \"Downhill Domination\".
1. Visual @COMMENT_BODY@ Camera Setup:
• Perspective: Third-person camera view, locked closely behind the player's cyclist.
• Environment: A steep, rocky, and winding mountain dirt track that goes aggressively downwards. It must feature extreme vertical drops, dirt ramps for massive high jumps, and breakable obstacles like wooden fences.
• Aesthetic: Vibrant, fast-paced 90s arcade racing style.
2. Core Controls @COMMENT_BODY@ Movement:
• Physics: The bicycle constantly accelerates downward automatically due to intense gravity.
• Steering: Player uses 'A/D' or 'Left/Right Arrow' keys to steer sharply left and right.
• Pedal: Pressing 'W' or 'Up Arrow' allows the player to manually pedal for an extra speed burst.
• Jumping: Pressing 'Spacebar' executes a high bunny hop jump, designed to launch the bike off ramps.
3. Combat @COMMENT_BODY@ Style Trick Mechanics:
• Air Tricks: While airborne after a jump, holding the jump button allows the cyclist to perform style tricks. Successful tricks fill up a Nitro Boost meter.
• Combat System: On the ground, the player can attack rivals. Pressing 'Q' punches to the left, and pressing 'E' punches to the right. If a punch connects with an AI competitor, that rival crashes and spins out.
4. AI Opponents @COMMENT_BODY@ User Interface (UI):
• Enemies: Include 3 aggressive AI opponent cyclists who race down the hill alongside the player, actively trying to overtake and punch the player.
• HUD / UI Elements: Display a clean screen overlay featuring a Speedometer, a visual Progress Bar showing distance left to the finish line, and a Nitro Boost meter that glows when full. The game ends when the first cyclist crosses the finish line at the bottom of the mountain.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D downhill mountain bike arcade racing game inspired by *Downhill Domination*.

## Requirements
- Third-person downhill race with winding rocky track, steep drops, ramps, breakable fences, and vibrant arcade visuals.
- Controls: A/D or arrows to steer, W/up to pedal, Space to hop and hold in-air for tricks, Q/E to punch, Shift to use nitro.
- Three aggressive AI rivals, speedometer, finish progress bar, nitro meter, and race-end result.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking questions; note them briefly when finished.
- Save and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a standalone HTML canvas game without an external game engine.

## Work State
### Completed
- Completed game/menu/HUD/rendering/race logic in `index.html`, including touch controls, ramps, rival AI, fences, nitro, tricks, and finish results.
- Verified JavaScript syntax with `node --check`, HTTP 200 from `http://localhost:3002/index.html`, and browser gameplay with no JavaScript exceptions.
- Captured and inspected a 640×360 JPEG screenshot at `/tmp/opencode/ridge-rush.jpg`.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Report the completed implementation, validation, screenshot path, and brief assumptions to the user.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: complete standalone game implementation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; repository contains untracked files.
- Browser gameplay smoke test reported speed `56`, progress `1.08117%`, and no exceptions.
- Screenshot: `/tmp/opencode/ridge-rush.jpg`.

content.text:
Implemented the playable downhill arcade racer in `index.html`, with winding terrain, ramps, breakable fences, three AI rivals, nitro, tricks, combat, race HUD, touch controls, and finish results.

**To play:** run `./start.sh` and open the local address it prints.  
**Controls:** A/D or arrows to steer, W/up to pedal, Space to hop and hold for tricks, Q/E to punch, Shift to boost.

Validated JavaScript syntax and browser gameplay; no JavaScript exceptions during the smoke test. Captured and inspected a 640×360 screenshot at `/tmp/opencode/ridge-rush.jpg`.

Assumption: the game is a standalone HTML canvas implementation, with no external game engine.
